game: Grand Theft Auto: Vice City - The Definitive Edition

findings.name: Introduction
findings.detail: In The Beginning... ; An Old Friend (phone call from Sonny Forelli).

findings.name: Ken Rosenberg
findings.detail: The Party; Back Alley Brawl; Jury Fury; Riot. Riot is his final mission (trophy Legal Counsel).

findings.name: Avery Carrington
findings.detail: Four Iron; Demolition Man; Two Bit Hit. Per gta.wiki 100% page these 3 plus All Hands On Deck are NOT required for story progress but ARE required for 100%.

findings.name: Juan Cortez
findings.detail: Treacherous Swine; Mall Shootout; Guardian Angels (opens Starfish Island); Sir, Yes Sir!; All Hands On Deck! (final Cortez mission, trophy Life of the Party).

findings.name: Ricardo Diaz
findings.detail: The Chase; Phnom Penh '86 (opens Vice City mainland); The Fastest Boat; Supply & Demand (trophy South American Connection).

findings.name: Kent Paul / Lance Vance
findings.detail: Death Row (Kent Paul); Rub Out (Lance Vance; rewards the Vercetti Estate).

findings.name: Vercetti Estate missions (Tommy)
findings.detail: Shakedown; Bar Brawl; Cop Land. Shakedown unlocks the asset-purchase system (assets purchasable afterwards). Cop Land makes the Estate generate income.

findings.name: Umberto Robina
findings.detail: Stunt Boat Challenge; Cannon Fodder; Naval Engagement; Trojan Voodoo (final; trophy Big Heat from Little Havana).

findings.name: Auntie Poulet
findings.detail: Juju Scramble; Bombs Away!; Dirty Lickin's.

findings.name: Love Fist
findings.detail: Love Juice; Psycho Killer; Publicity Tour (final; trophy Chauffeur).

findings.name: Mitch Baker
findings.detail: Alloy Wheels of Steel; Messing with the Man; Hog Tied (final; trophy Tommy Two-Wheels).

findings.name: Print Works (final arc)
findings.detail: Print Works asset missions: Spilling the Beans; Hit the Courier; then Cap the Collector (first mission of final arc). Print Works costs $70,000 (console price per TheGamer), north of Starfish Island on second island.

findings.name: Keep Your Friends Close...
findings.detail: Final story mission, given to Tommy Vercetti. Starts at Vercetti Estate; requires at least $1,000 on hand or an error appears. Defend safe from mafia attackers, Lance Vance betrays Tommy, kill Lance on the roof, kill Sonny Forelli in the foyer. Reward $30,000 + Micro SMG; unlocks a Hunter at Fort Baxter Air Base (and at an Ocean Beach helipad if all 100 hidden packages collected). Trophy Mischief Managed (completion of this mission). Ending: Ken reappears, Tommy says no more trouble from up north; story complete.

findings.name: Final-mission unlock requirements (Cap the Collector)
findings.detail: Print Works is mandatory (high agreement). Cap the Collector requires Cop Land + Hit the Courier + 'five necessary assets completed' (gta.wiki). TheGamer: Vercetti Estate missions all done + Print Works + five other properties (cheap suggestion: Boatyard $10k Checkpoint Charlie; Cherry Popper $20k 50 deals in one session; Pole Position Club $30k spend $300 on dances; Kaufman Cabs $40k its missions; Sunshine Autos $50k steal listed cars). Another source says 6 assets (7 with Estate) and says Malibu Club + Print Works mandatory. SOURCES CONFLICT on exact count and on Malibu Club. gta.wiki 100% page says Phil's Place does not count toward the story asset requirement. Hyman Memorial Stadium etc. not assets.
findings.trackable: Not confirmed that the game displays a counter of completed assets; stats screen completion % only.
sources: search result summary of unlock guides

findings.name: Asset mission lines
findings.detail: Boatyard: Checkpoint Charlie. Cherry Popper Ice Cream Factory: Distribution. Pole Position Club: Club Pole Position. Sunshine Autos: Import Garage. InterGlobal Film Studio: Recruitment Drive, Dildo Dodo, Martha's Mug Shot, G-Spotlight. Kaufman Cabs: V.I.P., Friendly Rivalry, Cabmaggedon. Malibu Club: No Escape?, The Shootist, The Driver, The Job. Phil Cassidy: Gun Runner, Boomshine Saigon. Print Works: Spilling the Beans, Hit the Courier. Vercetti Estate: Shakedown, Bar Brawl, Cop Land. Note: gta.wiki page intro says 19 asset missions but lists 17 (excluding Print Works/Estate counting).
findings.trackable: Property count visible? PowerPyx: 17 total properties (7 safehouses + assets); 'Vice City Mogul' trophy = own 10 properties.

findings.name: Mission-specific missable trophies in the DE list
findings.detail: Iron-y (Four Iron: kill developer with golf club); Not my First Time (G-Spotlight: clear all PCJ-600 rooftop jumps without falling); Salutations My Little Friend (Rub Out: kill Diaz with M4); Chopper'd Up (Demolition Man: kill all 17 hostiles with RC chopper blades across 4 floors). Mission ends on kill, so save before.
